text:
maria_cs: quick heads-up — LatticeCore raised a renewal risk flag during yesterday's call. Their compliance team says audit logs must be retained 24 months, but our private deploy default is 90 days. Can we triage? :warning:

sanjay_eng: thanks — is this retention stored in their SIEM or on our managed audit export?

maria_cs: they want logs exported to their Splunk instance in their VPC and also a cold backup for 24 months. for the Splunk egress we already have an approved IP, but KMS key policies and IAM roles might block long-term archival.

leo_sre: I can check the export pipeline. quick Q: are they planning to use Redwood-managed S3 (customer-handoff) or host the bucket in their account?

emily_latticecore: we will host in our account (preferred). Redwood will push audit events via VPC peering to an S3 bucket in our account. Need to ensure CMK trust and cross-account role.

maria_cs: got it. blockers we need to resolve before renewal call: (1) KMS key policy allows Redwood service principal to Encrypt/Decrypt for archival operations; (2) IAM role trust for audit-export lambda; (3) lifecycle policy to move to Glacier; (4) confirm network egress routes for Splunk if they want streaming as well.

sanjay_eng: sample cross-account trust policy I typically send customers — please validate and we can put it in the runbook:

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"Service": "redwood-inference-exporter.amazonaws.com"},
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
      "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:SourceAccount": "123456789012"}}
    }
  ]
}
```

sanjay_eng: also will need the CMK policy like:
```
{
  "Sid": "AllowRedwoodUse",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::999999999999:role/redwood-exporter"},
  "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:ReEncrypt*","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```

leo_sre: I'll validate the exporter principal and confirm whether our exporter uses an assumed-role ARN or a service principal. If they host the bucket we also need bucket policy snippet.

maria_cs: Emily — can you paste the Splunk ingest hostname + preferred retention lifecycle? Also tell us whether retention must be immutable (WORM) or just 24 months recyclable.

emily_latticecore: Splunk ingest: splunk-lattice-east.company.net:8088. Retention: immutable archive for 24 months (regulatory eDiscovery). We also need audit log hash digest snapshots kept for verification.

sanjay_eng: ok immutable archive means we need an architecture that avoids server-side deletion. We can push to an S3 bucket in their account and set object-lock governance mode + retention period. That requires account-level permissions and CMK allowing kms:PutObjectRetention.

maria_cs: Risk notes for renewal deck: "Customer asks for 24mo immutable audit retention; current default 90d; requires cross-account CMK + object-lock; could add one-time engineering task; potential additional charge for cold storage."

leo_sre: action items (assigning inline): @sanjay_eng — update runbook with CMK + role snippets and object-lock steps; estimate effort. @maria_cs — coordinate legal/compliance copy for renewal slide. @emily_latticecore — confirm bucket name and provide admin ARN for cross-account grant. I'll check exporter principal and network path. ops-bot: create issue? :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: created issue RDW-4578: "LatticeCore audit-retention: cross-account CMK + object-lock for 24mo" — assigned to sanjay_eng, leo_sre. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/RDW-4578

sanjay_eng: initial estimate — 2 dev-days to update exporter and runbook, plus 1/2 day for validation with customer (assuming they provide bucket + admin ARN). Potential follow-up: enable additional billing metric for cold storage.

maria_cs: perfect. Emily — can we aim to have the admin ARN + bucket by EOD Thursday? If not, tell us timeline so we can update the renewal playbook.

emily_latticecore: aiming EOD Thursday. small caveat: security will run an internal review and may ask for a short MOU for key access.

maria_cs: noted. I'll add that to the renewal risk summary. If security requires MOU, that could delay by a week — call that a medium risk.

leo_sre: technical checklist I'll update in runbook: network path, peering route table, export IAM role, CMK policy, bucket policy, object-lock enablement, validation steps (sha256 snapshot check), and post-cutover monitoring queries.

maria_cs: thanks all. we'll reconvene Friday 10am PT for a quick sync after Emily gets the bucket details. :calendar:

emily_latticecore: thanks team!
